faqs.question: What are Shadcn Beam Illustrations?
faqs.answer: Shadcn Beam Illustrations are pre-built beam components built with Shadcn UI and Tailwind CSS that connect nodes, icons, and files with a looping beam animation.

faqs.question: What types of Beam layouts are included?
faqs.answer: The collection includes Gradient Beam for glowing gradient connections, Dot Beam for a traveling dot animation, Data Flow Beam for softly lit directional connectors, and Pipeline Beam for progress-style transfer-rate visuals.

faqs.question: Is the beam animation live or a static preview?
faqs.answer: Each card includes an animated beam, and you can view the live beam animation using the "Preview" action shown on the card.

faqs.question: Can I customize the nodes, icons, and beam style?
faqs.answer: Yes. Since the components are built with Shadcn UI and Tailwind CSS, you can edit the nodes, icons, colors, and beam animation in the source code to match your project.

faqs.question: Will I get Pro beam variants with the package?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Pro, Enterprise, and Team plan comes with Pro blocks included.

faqs.question: How do I get in touch?
faqs.answer: You can reach us for any account, billing, or license questions through the chat feature located at the bottom right corner of our website's pages.

faqs.question: What are Shadcn Miscellaneous Illustrations?
faqs.answer: Shadcn Miscellaneous Illustrations are pre-built, animated misc illustrations built with Shadcn UI and Tailwind CSS that cover varied product ideas such as fintech, AI input, checklists, and backgrounds.

faqs.question: What types of miscellaneous illustrations are included?
faqs.answer: The collection includes Animated Grid, Balance Tracker, Secure Access, Prompt Composer, Checklist, User Signup Funnel, Color Switcher & Motion Path, Transactions, Integration Hub, Code File Stack, Voice Assistant, Rocket Boost, Falling Text, Visual Effects, Phone Frame, AI Interfaces, and Productivity Widget.

faqs.question: Are the misc illustrations animated or static?
faqs.answer: Each card includes motion, such as autoplay, looping, or hover-reactive animation, and you can view it live using the "Preview" action shown on the card.

faqs.question: Can I customize the miscellaneous illustrations?
faqs.answer: Yes. Since the components are built with Shadcn UI and Tailwind CSS, you can edit the content, colors, and animation behavior in the source code to match your project.

faqs.question: Will I get Pro misc illustrations with the package?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Pro, Enterprise, and Team plan comes with Pro blocks included.

faqs.question: How do I get in touch?
faqs.answer: You can reach us for any account, billing, or license questions through the chat feature located at the bottom right corner of our website's pages.

globalFaqs.question: What are shadcn/ui illustrations?
globalFaqs.answer: shadcn/ui illustrations are pre-built animated and static visual components - orbiting icons, stacked cards, ripple effects, marquees, and more. Unlike layout blocks, illustrations focus on motion and visual polish, and you install and own the source code entirely.

globalFaqs.question: What is the difference between shadcn/ui blocks and illustrations?
globalFaqs.answer: Blocks are complete layout sections like heroes, pricing tables, and dashboards. Illustrations are self-contained visual components focused on motion and graphics, such as an orbiting icon set or a ripple effect, that you drop inside a block or section to add visual depth.

globalFaqs.question: What types of shadcn/ui illustrations does Shadcn Studio offer?
globalFaqs.answer: Shadcn Studio offers 50+ illustrations, including Orbit, Card Stack, Ripple, and Marquee illustrations. New illustration categories are added regularly.

globalFaqs.question: Can I use shadcn/ui illustrations with Next.js?
globalFaqs.answer: Yes - all Shadcn Studio illustrations are built for Next.js App Router and Pages Router and are compatible as React Server Components. They also work with Astro, Vite + React, React Router, and TanStack Start.

globalFaqs.question: Are shadcn/ui illustrations customizable?
globalFaqs.answer: Yes - illustrations install as source files directly in your project so you own and edit every line. Colors, sizing, and animation speed are controlled by Tailwind CSS utility classes and your shadcn/ui theme tokens.

globalFaqs.question: Can I save illustrations to a favorites list?
globalFaqs.answer: Yes - every illustration includes a favorite icon, so you can add it to your personal favorites list while browsing and come back to it later without having to search for it again.

globalFaqs.question: How do I install a shadcn/ui illustration?
globalFaqs.answer: Each illustration installs with a single CLI command: npx shadcn\@latest add [illustration-url]. Alternatively, copy the source code directly from the illustration preview page and paste it into your project.

globalFaqs.question: Are Shadcn Studio Pro illustrations included in the Pro plan?
globalFaqs.answer: Yes - the Pro plan unlocks the full illustration library, including all current and future illustration releases at no extra cost. A selection of illustrations is also available for free.

globalFaqs.question: Do shadcn/ui illustrations support dark mode?
globalFaqs.answer: Yes - all illustrations inherit your shadcn/ui theme's CSS variables, so they switch between light and dark mode automatically when you toggle the dark class. No per-illustration dark mode configuration is needed.

globalFaqs.question: Do illustrations affect page performance?
globalFaqs.answer: No - illustrations are built with lightweight, performance-friendly CSS and JavaScript animations, so they add visual motion without noticeably impacting load times or page performance.

globalFaqs.question: Where can I get support for Shadcn Studio illustrations?
globalFaqs.answer: Support is available via the Discord community and email. Pro plan members receive priority support with faster response times.

globalFaqs.question: Can I use free Shadcn illustrations in commercial projects?
globalFaqs.answer: Yes. The free illustrations can be used in unlimited personal and commercial projects, including client work and SaaS products. Reselling the source files as a competing product is not permitted.

globalFaqs.question: Do I need an account to use the free Shadcn illustrations?
globalFaqs.answer: No. The free illustrations require no account, no credit card and no trial period - copy the source or install with the shadcn CLI straight away.

globalFaqs.question: Do they work with my existing shadcn/ui theme?
globalFaqs.answer: Yes. Every illustration uses standard shadcn CSS variables, so it inherits your colours, radius, and dark mode automatically. Any theme from the Theme Generator, tweakcn, or your own globals.css works.

globalFaqs.question: Can I turn the animation off?
globalFaqs.answer: Yes. Pass animate={false} for a static render. Animations also respect the user's prefers-reduced-motion setting by default.
